0022600184.text: The Dallas Mavericks (4-3, 9th in the West, 4th in the Southwest, 2.5 games back) visit the San Antonio Spurs (5-2, 6th in the West, 3rd in the Southwest, 1.5 games back), who enter on a five-game winning streak while Dallas has lost its last game. Dallas is missing Dereck Lively II, Max Christie, Santi Aldama, Sergio de Larrea and Tarik Biberovic, and San Antonio is without Jayden Quaintance and Tobias Harris. The Mavericks trail the 2026-27 season series 0-1 after a 122-106 loss in Dallas on 2026-10-24, and they were swept 0-4 by San Antonio in 2025-26.
